families.mechanism: the book's own imbalance predicts the mid move by more than a round trip
families.minimum_data: forward quote/depth at the touch, point-in-time
families.why: the capture exists and was measured; the best long-only gross is far below the barrier and the tape offers no clearing move at a 1 or 5 second horizon

families.mechanism: momentum or reversal only in a regime observable in real time
families.minimum_data: OHLCV point-in-time plus volatility and volume
families.why: klines are available but a bar close is not a decision instant this runtime would trade on; the package does not open a new window for it, and no arm here survived the cost gate to justify one

families.mechanism: BTC leads or lags ETH and the alts by more than the round trip
families.minimum_data: synchronised bars, one venue and one clock
families.why: the captured clock is one venue, but three symbols over a few hours cannot separate a lead/lag effect from a shared move; the sample is declared too small

families.mechanism: positioning imbalances are exploitable after their publication instant
families.minimum_data: funding and OI history with the real publication time
families.why: funding history is available and OI is retained for about 30 days; the forward capture held only 14 usable quadrant states, below the registered floor of 500, so the family is deferred rather than rejected on a sample too small to judge

families.minimum_data: an event feed with publication timestamps
families.why: no public liquidation or event feed answered in this environment (probe 404), and a retrospective timestamp cannot be used as a publication instant
